name: Scientific AI Image SEO & Alt Text
author: scientificai

sections.description:
Scientific AI Image SEO & Alt Text is an audit-and-repair dashboard for WordPress image ALT text.

Unlike automatic ALT generators, the Free plugin focuses on reviewing the existing Media Library, measuring ALT coverage, finding gaps, and letting an editor repair ALT text from one screen. Filename-derived suggestions are generated locally from existing attachment filenames; the Free plugin does not send images or content to an AI service.

Free features:
* Scan the WordPress Media Library
* Measure site-wide image ALT coverage
* Find images with missing ALT text
* View images with and without ALT text
* Edit and save ALT text directly from one dashboard
* Generate simple local filename-derived ALT suggestions
* Run an Image Usage & Context Audit for the images shown on the dashboard
* See which posts, pages or products use an image
* Flag filename-like ALT text, duplicate ALT text and images reused in multiple contexts
* Filter images by ALT status
* No OpenAI API key required
* No external AI service required
* No licence key required

This makes the Free plugin especially useful as a privacy-friendly ALT coverage audit and manual repair workflow rather than an automatic AI ALT generator.

An optional, separately distributed Scientific AI Image SEO Pro add-on adds AI-powered ALT text and SEO filename generation, multilingual output, brand and keyword rules, bulk optimization, automatic optimization on upload, and WooCommerce image support.

External Services

This Free plugin does not contact OpenAI or any other third-party AI service.
All Free features run on your WordPress site and no API key is required.

The separately distributed Pro add-on has its own external-service requirements and documentation.

Privacy

Scientific AI Image SEO & Alt Text Free does not include analytics, tracking, telemetry, or advertising beacons.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the Scientific AI Image SEO ZIP file.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open Scientific AI > Image SEO.
sections.faq:
Is the Free plugin an automatic ALT text generator?

No. The Free plugin is an audit-and-repair workflow. It finds missing ALT text, measures coverage, lets editors update ALT text from one dashboard, and offers local filename-derived suggestions. It does not automatically analyse images with AI.

Does the Free version require an OpenAI API key?

No. The Free version works without an API key and does not contact an external AI service.

Does the Free version require a licence key?

No. A licence is only required for Pro features.

What is the Image Usage & Context Audit?

It is a local, on-demand audit that checks the images displayed on the current dashboard page. It shows where each image is used in WordPress content and flags missing ALT text, filename-like ALT text, duplicate ALT text, and images reused across multiple contexts for manual review.

Does the audit send my content to an external service?

No. The Free usage/context audit runs locally against your WordPress database and does not use an AI API.

Does it change image files?

The Free version does not rename or replace image files. It lets you review and edit WordPress image ALT text.

Can I use it with WooCommerce?

The Free dashboard can see normal Media Library image attachments. Dedicated WooCommerce product/gallery image workflows are available in Pro.
